title: A write key cannot retire another writer's trusted note with a clean-looking replacement alone
what: A second writer (not distrusted, not an admin) previews and confirms a replacement of a trusted writer's note with a false but clean-looking value. The preview and confirm are both allowed for any write key today; the check says the trusted note should survive unless an admin agrees. Honest result on this commit: it does not.

expect.desc: the trusted note is still in an ordinary search after another writer's replacement
